column2: min/max can be the effective min/max, not allowed. E.g., if everyone should have at least 20 power, it can be 20 instead of 0 even though 0 is possible.
column5: H/P/B (hitter/pitcher/both), which to use when fitting
column6: Used to filter, only includes players that throw this pitch
column8: Names of up to 3 stats from OOTP that will be used to map to the MVP stat. If more than 1, they need weights that will be used to combine the quantiles, the result of which will be taken as quantiles to map to MVP stat.
